notes: ProOS master integration catalog. Protech-owned source of truth for which HA integrations installers may use and how they're supported. Synced down to every ProCore. Edit here, commit, and each site picks it up on next sync. Tiers: 'certified' (Protech add-on with awareness/monitoring layer), 'native' (stock HA integration, usable but NOT maintained by Protech), 'hidden' (not shown to installers).

apple_tv.label: Apple TV
apple_tv.notes: ProOS build. Two-signal watcher (device ping + integration health) distinguishes asleep vs offline vs wedged.

samsungtv_smart.label: Samsung TV
samsungtv_smart.notes: ProOS build. Full power/source/AVR control with TV-state awareness.

homekit.label: Apple Home Bridge
homekit.notes: ProOS-configured HomeKit bridge (opt-in switchboard, full-restart apply).

elkm1.label: Elk-M1 Security
elkm1.notes: Native HA integration. Candidate for certification (alarm-state awareness).
